content.title: LiveRamp (NYSE:RAMP) Exceeds Q3 Expectations
content.summary: Data collaboration platform LiveRamp (NYSE:RAMP) reported Q3 CY2025 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with sales up 7.7% year on year to $199.8 million.
